instructions.purpose: Remove one configured read-only calendar source.

tool.name: remove-readonly-calendar
tool.description: Removes only a row classified as read-only and rejects the writable calendar.

usage_rules.rule: List calendars first unless the user supplied one exact configured ID.
Return ambiguous matches to Main. Treat removal as authorized only by an explicit request.

example.context: User explicitly asks to remove family@example.com.
